sentences.text: Evtepia gabavorous is reported as a GABA-consuming species of the human gut microbiome.
A meta-analysis consolidating five case-control studies covering 1007 fecal samples reported elevated levels of GABA-consuming species, particularly Evtepia gabavorous, in Parkinson's disease.
The authors of that meta-analysis suggest this contributes to neuronal excitability.
A shotgun metagenomics study of patients with idiopathic normal pressure hydrocephalus reported enrichment of Evtepia gabavorous specifically associated with clinical traits of that condition.
